record.title: Reversal invariance conjecture for the Thue–Morse sequence in base $3/2$
record.statement: Let $x_{3/2}$ be the binary Thue–Morse sequence in base $3/2$. record.title: Hansen's biregular interval-colourability conjecture
record.statement: A graph is **biregular** if it is bipartite and all vertices in the same part have the same degree. record.title: Graffiti's cut-vertex lower bound for the independence number
record.statement:
Let $G$ be a graph, let $\alpha(G)$ be its independence number, and let $c(G)$ be the number of cut-vertices of $G$. **Graffiti's cut-vertex conjecture.**

\alpha(G) \geq 1+\frac{c(G)}{2}

record.title: Renner–Wolf conjecture on reduced intrinsic information and secret-key rate
record.statement:
Let $P_{XYZ}$ be a probability distribution. The **Renner–Wolf conjecture.**

$$
S(X:Y||Z)=I(X:Y \downarrow \downarrow Z).
$$

The reduced intrinsic information is a known upper bound on the secret-key rate and can be strictly smaller than the intrinsic information. Equality would give a simple distribution-based characterization of the secret-key rate; the paper presents this as an open problem.

record.title: The main conjecture on degree-\a0$k+1$ vertices in minimal $k$-extendable bipartite graphs
record.statement:
Let $G$ be a minimal $k$-extendable bipartite graph, with $k\geqslant 1$, order $n$, and size $m=|E(G)|$. Let $V_{k+1}$ be the set of vertices of degree precisely $k+1$. **Main conjecture.**

|V_{k+1}|\geqslant \frac{2}{2k-1}(m-n+2k).
